name: Aurekomest
backstory: Child of Khaumestro and Aurekobo, in Gorff; grew up around drives a caravan up and down the transit..., and picked up a little of Birth Of Farliauzco along the way.

Had a child with Aurelkhau, named Aurelkomest.

Heard that Khaubaluk and Aurekhobo now have a child, Khaubekho.

criterion.standard: holds themself accountable to Birth Of Merkhaubo, whatever it costs
criterion.wasted_life: one that never had to answer for Birth Of Merkhaubo
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed
